name: cadence
description: Learn languages with Echo and save your practice in your private Cadence app.

interface.longDescription: Connect your private Cadence account to ChatGPT. Read your learning goals, practise a language with Echo, save summaries of completed lessons, and build a personal collection of useful review phrases. Saved lessons and phrases appear in the Cadence app. Uses your Cadence login and explicit OAuth consent; no AI API key is required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Cadence to help me start a language lesson with Echo and save the useful practice afterwards.
